conditions: Still-image routes use Gemini text prompting when needed, then render through the FLUX local service.
image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded antique-market object or scene illustration, readable subject, realistic wear, no visible text, no watermark.
image_generation.default_prompt_template: {domain_label}. Create one polished still image of {image_subject} for {actor_name} and {target_name}. Keep it grounded in a lived-in antique market with paperwork, stalls, cases, and urban wear. No visible text, no watermark.

inventory_generation.policy: Generate compact role-appropriate actionable inventory only from the item catalog. Use property_library for non-actionable treasures, titles, clues, personal tools, debts, or keepsakes. Do not create images here; image generation is a later system step when a route requests it.
inventory_generation.reason: Boutique character node already generated at least eight validated inventory items per agent.

functions.purpose: Create or advance event threads for the The Patent Heist loop so the world keeps generating concrete next steps in Patent Vault, Security Hub, Ventilation Shafts.
functions.event_policy: Prefer compact progress events that deepen The Patent Heist: Infiltrate the high-security vault to steal a proprietary fungal genome and escape before the lockdown. Use Infiltrator, Hacker, Lookout as likely responders, keep the pressure on Rising spore toxicity levels, and ensure at least one event gives players a readable way into the world such as A disgraced researcher seeking to reclaim a stolen genome..
